**Severity:** error · **Area:** Static calls (i18n) (`RV4xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads one of:

```text
{export}() arguments cannot be spread
```

```text
{export}() takes a key and an optional params object
```

```text
{export}() key must be a string literal or a prefixed template literal (`prefix.${x}`)
```

```text
{export}.in() key must be a string literal
```

```text
{export}() params must be an object literal
```

```text
Prefixed keys must not take params
```

```text
Prefixed keys must not take params ("{k}")
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Call `t()` with a literal key and an inline object literal of params: `t("greet", { name, age })`.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
import { t } from "@rivetjs/i18n";
declare const params: any;
export const x = t("greet", params);
```

```tsx prefer
import { t } from "@rivetjs/i18n";
export const x = t("greet", { name: "Bo", age: 2 });
```

## When it is reported

Build only.
